The '''NTB-630 naval bomber''' was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] manufactured during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] and [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporations]]. Built for at least one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and designed to attack [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the NTB-630 was better armed and more maneuverable than the similar [[PTB-625 planetary bomber/Legends|PTB-625 planetary bomber]]. The [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] employed many of these bombers during the Clone Wars, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wom-Nii Gnaden/Legends|Wom-Nii Gnaden]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an NTB-630 bomber during the [[Battle of Crombach Nebula/Legends|Battle of Crombach Nebula]].

==Characteristics==
The NTB-630 [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] was jointly produced by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] and [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporations]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The NTB-630 was more heavily armed and [[Armor/Legends|armored]] than its close cousin, the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]], and the similar [[PTB-625 planetary bomber/Legends|PTB-625 planetary bomber]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> With a narrow spaceframe flanked by at least two large [[Engine/Legends|engines]], the NTB-630 resembled other Incom/Subpro [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] such as the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], the PTB-625, and the ARC-170.<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|arc170fighter|ARC-170 starfighter}}</ref> The NTB-630 was created to deliver its payloads while engaged in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Space warfare/Legends|battles]], and was therefore also more maneuverable than the PTB-625, allowing it to get close to [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and avoid their [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] as it executed bombing runs.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|393|NTB-630}}</ref> The bomber was crewed by at least one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

==History==
The bomber saw common use by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|forces]] during the Clone Wars. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wom-Nii Gnaden/Legends|Wom-Nii Gnaden]] piloted an NTB-630 during the [[Battle of Crombach Nebula]], and crashed into the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] ''[[Tide of Progress XII/Legends|Tide of Progress XII]]''<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> after his bomber was damaged, causing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to lose control of his [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The NTB-630 naval bomber was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2005]] book detailing vehicles seen in the film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. This page was reprinted in [[2007]] in ''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''. Later, the bomber was mentioned in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry of the ARC-170 starfighter on [[StarWars.com]], and it also received its own entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
